suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as treatment complication. Apply to Graves hyperthyroidism treated with total thyroidectomy or ablative/high-dose radioiodine followed by hypothyroidism requiring replacement. Definitive-treatment consequence; do not infer hypothyroidism from untreated hyperthyroidism. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
